items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: He graduated in ’53 you see. So I think back in the earlier 50s, that’s how they were paid.

ctx.x: Well they do have a tradition here at Hamilton, but they don’t call it milk punch but it’s something. Dick Sherman told me that sometimes you guys got paid with a fifth of good whiskey. Is that true?
That was true. He graduated in ’53 you see. So I think back in the earlier 50s, that’s how they were paid. But no, we wanted cash. It was a little easier to choose our own booze
